s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic multisystem disease with autoimmune features, characterized by skin, joint, and lung involvement, with a prolonged course of symptoms and significant weight loss
salient_findings: Symmetric swelling of metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints with ulcers
Dyspigmentation and atrophy of distal fingers
Interstitial lung disease on chest CT
key_facts: 7-month history of fatigue, exertional dyspnea, arthralgias, hand swelling, tender ulcerations, hair loss, and weight loss
Previous hospitalization for hypoxia
Prior treatment with prednisone
Symmetric joint swelling preventing fist formation
Normal capillaroscopy
Ulcerated lichenoid papules on palmar IP creases
Oxford Scale muscle strength 5 of 5 throughout
Bibasilar rales on auscultation
Elevated ferritin levels
Depressed creatine kinase levels
Lymphocytopenia with CD3, CD4, and CD8 counts provided
Positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies
Positive immunoglobulin G anticardiolipin antibodies
Negative results for various antibodies and tests as listed
Normal prothrombin time, partial thromboplastin time, and tissue thromboplastin
Chest CT findings of hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial thickening, and perilymphatic ground glass opacities
Worsening interstitial lung disease on follow-up Chest CT
Bronchoscopy revealed plaquelike lesions
Transbronchial nodal aspiration of mediastinal nodes was negative for carcinomas/granulomas
Pulmonary function tests showed restrictive disease with decreased diffusing capacity

shortlist.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies, lymphocytopenia, and multisystem involvement

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showing orthokeratosis, basal vacuolar change, and diffuse vasculopathy, along with symmetric joint swelling and ulcerated lichenoid papules

shortlist.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies and interstitial lung disease

shortlist.label: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Overlap of features from lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and scleroderma, including joint swelling, interstitial lung disease, and positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies

shortlist.label: Systemic Sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Interstitial lung disease, skin thickening, and positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies, although some features like esophageal dysmotility are not mentioned
